rules: All ADT values are checked against an exact nominal family and type specialization before admission
Variant tag + exact product field set are required; no implicit None/Err conversion
Private/opaque capabilities, borrowed references and resources cannot be nested to bypass Sendable
DATA cannot mint CONTROL; CONTROL notices require host authority separate from all guest payload fields
Panic notice points to an accepted currently-running message and its exact generation
CONTROL is delivered before scheduling new DATA even with a full bounded mailbox
Every admitted message is completed, failed or explicitly discarded once
Old actor generations and callback identities cannot settle work in a restarted generation
Malformed JSON, duplicate fields, invalid UTF8, oversized or too-deep payloads fail before handler
Host reference tests are not evidence for compiled actor guest execution
